capabilities: Draft comic scripts with drag-and-drop pages, panels and dialogue/caption/SFX blocks
Keep a series of issues ordered in projects with numbering, stats and export folders
Export scripts to editable Word .docx files with comments and revision markers
Comment in margins on blocks or selected words with threaded replies
Customize block types, numbering style, editor appearance and export options
extras: States no network access and no telemetry; releases come with signed build attestations verifiable via gh; requires Obsidian 1.5.7 or newer.
problem: Obsidian has no editor for comic script formatting (page/panel/balloon structure, Greg Pak template layout) or for managing a series of issues as ordered projects.

relations.evidence: A project keeps a series together, like Longform but simpler.
Export .docx writes the template's styles: a page break per comic page

summary: Comic script editor that drafts scripts with drag-and-drop pages, panels and lettering blocks, organizes issues into projects, and exports to editable Word files.
